snippet.title: Celebrating 15 years of Rushing
snippet.description:
15 years of towers, honor and glory, heroes, epic adventures, easter eggs, and exploding sheep. 15 years of RUSHING!

To celebrate 15 years of Kingdom Rush, we’re bringing back where it all began with a brand-new way to experience Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis.

⚔️ Introducing CLASSIC MODE.
Play through the entire Genesis campaign with the iconic towers from the original Kingdom Rush, complete with their classic upgrade paths. Command a single hero. Call down Reinforcements and Rain of Fire once again. Defend the kingdom the way it all began.

For 15 years, you’ve built towers, defended Linirea, and stood your ground against impossible odds. This mode is our tribute to everyone who’s been with us on that journey.
Thank you for 15 incredible years of Kingdom Rush. 🏰❤️

👉 Wishlist Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4259190/Kingdom_Rush_6_Genesis_TD/?utm_source=social&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=15th_anniversary

📱 Pre-order Kingdom Rush Genesis on Mobile:
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ironhidegames.android.kingdomrush6.genesis&utm_source=trailer&utm_medium=youtube&utm_campaign=pre_register
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kingdom-rush-6-genesis-td/id6759664029

✉️ Subscribe to the Newsletter for Weekly Devlogs and updates:
https://www.kingdomrushgenesis.com/
